shots.title: Ask for a deep plan
shots.line: It reads the code first, then questions the goal.

shots.label: deep-plan
shots.title: You answer the forks
shots.line: Every hard-to-undo choice comes to you, with a recommendation.

shots.label: The plan
shots.title: Non-goals
shots.line: What it won't do comes first, before you argue with what it will.

shots.label: The plan
shots.title: Decisions
shots.line: Each fork you answered, with its reason. Nothing decided quietly.

shots.label: The plan
shots.title: Contracts
shots.line: Every API or table shape that changes. Reach is scouted; the call is yours.

shots.label: The plan
shots.title: Verified facts
shots.line: Claims cite path:line. A file it hasn't read is a file it can't plan.

shots.label: The plan
shots.title: Risks
shots.line: A claim nobody could cite. You settle each one: accept, mitigate, spike or promote.

shots.label: The plan
shots.title: Diagrams
shots.line: Each answers a question, in plain words first, with detail one tab away.

shots.label: The plan
shots.title: Increments
shots.line: Small steps, each listing the exact checks that will run.

shots.label: Alignment check
shots.title: A short quiz
shots.line: Before any code, it checks the plan says what you think it says.

shots.label: .seamux/verify.json
shots.title: Checks are recipes
shots.line: Unit tests, a real browser, and lookout reviews, matched to the files a step touches.

shots.label: The board
shots.line: You press go. One increment opens; the gate refuses the rest.

shots.label: deep-plan check run
shots.title: The checks run
shots.line: Lint and unit tests pass, and the checkout page passes in headless Chromium.
